# The Snagov Files (generated by tools/romania_focus_gen/dracula.py).
ROM_update_veil = {
	clamp_variable = { var = ROM_veil min = 0 max = 100 }
}

ROM_update_ritual = {
	clamp_variable = { var = ROM_ritual min = 0 max = 100 }
}

# Dread 0-100: political power +0.2% and stability +0.1% per point, research -0.1%,
# trade opinion -0.25%, resistance to foreign ideologies +0.5%.
ROM_update_dread = {
	clamp_variable = { var = ROM_dread min = 0 max = 100 }
	set_variable = { ROM_dread_pp = ROM_dread }
	divide_variable = { ROM_dread_pp = 500 }
	set_variable = { ROM_dread_stab = ROM_dread }
	divide_variable = { ROM_dread_stab = 1000 }
	set_variable = { ROM_dread_res = ROM_dread }
	divide_variable = { ROM_dread_res = -1000 }
	set_variable = { ROM_dread_trade = ROM_dread }
	divide_variable = { ROM_dread_trade = -400 }
	set_variable = { ROM_dread_drift = ROM_dread }
	divide_variable = { ROM_dread_drift = 200 }
}

# Called once a month from ROM_paths_monthly while ROM_dracula_path is set.
ROM_dracula_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = ROM_dread }
		add_to_variable = { ROM_dread = -1 }
		ROM_update_dread = yes
	}
	# after the resurrection the secret cannot hold
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = ROM_drac_voivode_returned }
		add_to_variable = { ROM_veil = -1 }
		ROM_update_veil = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = ROM_veil
			check_variable = { ROM_veil < 30 }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = ROM_drac_suspicion_fired }
		}
		set_country_flag = ROM_drac_suspicion_fired
		country_event = { id = ROM_drac.14}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = ROM_drac_voivode_returned
			check_variable = { ROM_dread > 69 }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = ROM_drac_uprising_cooldown }
		}
		random = {
			chance = 25
			set_country_flag = { flag = ROM_drac_uprising_cooldown days = 365 value = 1 }
			country_event = { id = ROM_drac.13}
		}
	}
}
